gates.title: Atom identity, partition, and shared contracts
One link boundary and its derivatives
One local model and its adapter
Joint capped cavity and transferred ligand

requirements.statement: Physical energy and coordinate-transfer implementations remain independent.
Stable real-atom identities, fixed ML membership, and complete mobile ligands survive remapping.
The embedding owns an explicit retained-MM, ML, and coupling interaction ledger.
Link-coordinate derivatives are propagated once to every affected real parent.
Box, image, cap, graph, and transform conventions agree at every evaluation.
The physical result includes forces on every coordinate that influences its energy, including MM atoms.
Environment-dependent inputs are recomputed for each mapped geometry; caches cannot change the Hamiltonian.
Derived link sites have no independent thermal degree of freedom or unintended classical interaction.
Disconnected-component additivity is a local-model test, never a universal embedding assumption.
Coordinates, energies, forces, timestep, precision, and conversion policy have explicit units.
Every physical term has exactly one owner and a declared ATM child/outside scope.
All intended forces are active in preparation and production integration.
Raw endpoints and mapped forces match independent evaluation with explicit diagnostic ordering.
Software, model weights, license review, and checkpoint-loading policy are recorded and reproducible.
Fresh-process reload, restart, parameter changes, and worker devices preserve the declared state.
Endpoint signs, binding domains, restraints, and standard-state corrections are explicit.
Directional midpoint identity is demonstrated or a measured bridge is included.
Saved raw energies reconstruct the actual sampled reduced potentials and schedule.
Overlap, correlation, and covariance enter the uncertainty assessment.
Admitted counterfactual geometries have finite, usable model energies and consistent forces.
AToM-specific keys, classes, force groups, and units stay inside the workflow adapter.
One- and two-ligand protocols use the same physical and ATM interfaces from the first analytic tests.
Unsupported chemistry, capabilities, force classes, and combinations fail explicitly.
Schema changes are versioned, reviewed, and tested against prior serialized fixtures.
Qualification is scoped to a complete configuration and requires evidence, not a support flag.
Specification, failing test, minimum implementation, refactor, and review are traceable.
Performance optimizations preserve the qualified Hamiltonian and deterministic tests.
Future extension contracts do not imply electrostatic, metal, or reactive support.
Workers need no unrecorded download and load only approved executable artifacts.
Independent oracles and deliberately injected faults demonstrate that checks detect errors.
Protein ABFE and RBFE reuse one cavity/model/boundary definition for comparable results.
Absent hardware, skipped tests, and short pilots cannot be reported as numerical qualification.

tests.expected_behavior: Confirm native ATMForce, PythonForce selected-particle support, mixed-system info API, serialization APIs, and reported versions; missing requirements fail clearly.
Record package builds, full source commits, platform, Python patch version and dependency result; tag and reported package version remain separate.
A wrong digest or absent authorization record is rejected before deserialization; an approved local asset is identifiable without network.
Exercise the actual PyTorch/checkpoint loading policy in a fresh process; never globally weaken loading policy to admit arbitrary files.
tests.applicability: Actual neural-model candidate profiles; not core-analytic-cpu.

tests.expected_behavior: Absent CUDA records not_run/unsupported profile, never a successful GPU qualification.
Duplicate residue numbers across chains remain distinct; real IDs survive reordering; ambiguous identities fail explicitly.
Resolve complete ligands and all boundary edges; reject incomplete ligands, ring/ligand cuts, duplicate group membership and unsupported fragments.
Round-trip reviewed JSON fixtures without changing order/units; reject unknown major schema versions and incompatible required fields.
Import shared records/protocol descriptions without OpenMM, model weights or CUDA; reject disallowed module dependencies.
A requested actual electrostatic profile is rejected rather than relabeled mechanical; a declared capability is not marked qualified.
A status update without requirement/test/profile/reviewer evidence cannot satisfy the acceptance schema.
At lambda 0, 0.37 and 1, raw child energies match hand-transformed direct evaluations and forces match their analytic weighted sum.
A selected-particle order [2, 0] gives the correct energy/force scatter; a factor-of-ten force error fails.
Unpack u1,u0,energy explicitly; a nonzero outside restraint appears once in total energy and not in raw child energy.
The same assembler accepts ABFE and RBFE with unequal group sizes and noncontiguous IDs; only specified groups move.
For the S04 harmonic coupling, moving only the MM atom changes energy; ATM translation changes its force; all real derivatives match.
Evaluate geometry A, then B, then A; the final A result matches the first and does not reuse stale mapped descriptors.
Deliberate wrong-index, omitted force, reversed raw tuple and stale-environment injections fail the appropriate checks.
The intended Python force is a child of ATM exactly once; the default name-based route is not accepted as proof.
Compare full force with the integrator-selected force using a deliberately large marker force in each relevant group.
The physical preparation copy is all-active; the reserved-group production copy cannot silently omit a physical term.
ABFE and RBFE upstream construction paths reproduce the same native-ATM observables without changing the physical builder.
Convert 0.5 fs to 0.0005 ps and nm displacements to Angstrom once; select protocol-specific upstream ligand keys only inside the adapter.
Reject an already nested ATM input, an occupied reserved force group, and a physical force left both outside and inside.
Construct the stated fixed-length cap from its actual parents; verify virtual-site type, mass, parameters and final count.
For axial/perpendicular real-parent perturbations, the analytic Jacobian and energy finite differences agree with returned real forces.
Distinct bond, angle, proper/improper torsion, exception and constraint fixtures have exactly the reviewed retained/removed disposition.
Consume current appended-site mapping and a synthetic nonidentity map; cap and ligand identities remain correct.
Both real parents receive exactly one cap contribution inside ATM; energy agreement alone cannot satisfy this check.
A harmonic cap-MM environment term produces both parent derivatives and the real environment derivative without double redistribution.
Same asset, ordered coordinates, box, dtype and energy convention agree within calibrated reference tolerances.
Native raw cap derivatives, projected by the independent oracle, match real-parent OpenMM forces.
A disconnected joint ML graph equals separately evaluated compatible components; the assertion is not applied to the total hybrid energy or a nonlocal provider.
Joint coordinate/box transformations and atom reordering preserve the expected scalar/vector behavior.
Admitted contact and cutoff scans yield finite values and interpretable repulsion; preserve failing alternate geometry and graph for diagnosis.
The exact checkpoint and output convention survive offline reload; no cache-dependent replacement or dtype change occurs.
Moving an MM probe changes expected real ML-MM Coulomb/LJ interactions; the cap creates no new classical interaction center.
Four charge-mask evaluations reproduce the cross contribution with consistent mesh, exceptions and nonneutral-background convention.
Catch a periodic cavity/cap/ligand reconnection missed by primary-box distances, including full-protein clearance.
Whole-molecule wrapping and admitted image-choice seams preserve the specified energy/force behavior or are explicitly excluded from the admitted domain.
Actual model edges, including periodic shifts, agree with the admitted independent distance/image search.
Charge offsets, LJPME, unqualified custom mixing or triclinic cells are rejected rather than approximated silently.
Direct physical, native ATM and AToM-built child/total energies and real forces match at both maps and intermediate states.
An MM boundary parent receives its full cap-induced derivative at both coordinate maps; omitted propagation fails.
Contacting input uses a joint graph; separated local-component behavior matches G05 without changing ML membership.
Protein real atoms, cap parents and cap sites have zero explicit displacement while complete ligand IDs move.
Swap only the analytic physical provider and reuse both protocols, assembler, records and checker; no embedding branch is added to common code.
Repeat the small admitted periodic version after the nonperiodic oracle passes; preserve both geometries on failure.
The specified constants give F1-F0=+1.5 kJ/mol, reverse=-1.5; kr=0 gives zero; quadrature and analytic samples agree.
For every declared state, reconstructed raw/softened/outside total equals direct context evaluation on saved frames.
A deliberately different directional midpoint is detected; including its independently evaluated bridge restores the known result.
Full finite-wall integral matches quadrature and limiting cases; standard-state sign follows the declared bound-minus-bulk convention.
Required uncomputed orientation/release/bridge entries prevent a final standard binding result; demonstrated zero needs evidence.
Independent estimators agree on identical reduced states; constant energy shifts cancel; covariance and correlated samples are treated as specified.
Bulk placement clears the full solute and relevant images; ligand retains classical solvent interactions.
Minimization/thermalization and production export share physical identity, constraints and all-active force semantics.
Reload expected PDB/System/State handover, then compare coordinates, box, parameters, constraints, energies and real forces before stepping.
Every saved pilot record preserves unambiguous raw energies, direction and state ID and permits independent reevaluation.
Pilot frames check caps, periodic separation, graph edges and nonfinite alternate-state behavior; failures archive both geometries.
The trusted bundle reconstructs with networking disabled and original model cache absent; exact asset identity remains unchanged.
Fixed-coordinate energy, forces, constraints, box and parameters agree; checkpoint and State guarantees are distinguished.
For a proposed swap, compare the actual exponent with independently evaluated cross-state reduced energies and state labels.
After each state change and restart, raw parameters/energies and state/replica histories are current, not stale or inferred from directories.
Admitted GPU worker uses the intended OpenMM device and model-tensor device; unavailable multigpu evidence stays unqualified.
Interrupt/resume preserves sample identity and avoids duplicated output or silently discarded records.
All selected identities/caps and chemistry are reviewed; at least one derivative component per real parent pair is checked.
All-MM, ligand-only and cavity-inclusive controls distinguish exact matched-constraint checks from intentional different-model ensembles.
The reported result includes explicit signs, restraints, midpoint connection and standard-state/release status.
Alternative admitted bulk placement and justified box-size checks produce a separate physical sensitivity record.
Realistic topology retains admitted force, restart, graph and counterfactual-domain behavior before sampled interpretation.
Complete A/B groups receive the prescribed opposite translations; protein/cap maps and identities remain unchanged.
Each endpoint connects the intended local-model ligand to the cavity and excludes unintended other-ligand/image contacts.
Symmetric A-to-A equilibrium difference is compatible with zero under predeclared uncertainty criteria, without requiring instantaneous perturbation zero.
Reversed endpoint labels negate the intended relative observable while preserving the same physical model and correction accounting.
Account for spectator-ligand, restraint, cavity/model/constraint and finite-box differences before interpreting closure.
The larger joint input uses the same physical builder, ATM assembler, observable schema and restart contracts without per-RBFE physics forks.
A clean admitted environment and offline asset bundle reproduce deterministic checks and required workflow evidence.
Every claimed capability references accepted gate/profile evidence; absent GPU or extended sampling results cannot be promoted.
Distinguish startup and steady state; ns/day=0.0864*dt_fs/step_seconds; aggregate resource estimates do not double-count replicas.
Any admitted routing/precision/invariant-term change passes endpoint, force, known-answer and affected regression checks.
Release statements distinguish implemented, smoke-tested, sampled, physically assessed and explicitly unsupported combinations.
